QuestInfo.name: Helping Riel
QuestInfo.0: Riel, Rael and Roel start betting on who will be offered to King Clang. The winner gets to be the sacrifice! How can I help these girls get to their senses? Let's first meet with #bRiel#k.
QuestInfo.1: Riel secretly asks to help her win the bet. Her deal is to defeat #r50 Clangs#k. How do I get myself into these situations? I'd better help her with this, and then talk about how ridiculous this bet is.\n\n#o4230104# #r#a21581##k

0.0: Hmm. Adventurer, will you please come here? (Whispering)
0.2: Of course, this is the kind of challenge for a winner to surpass. Still, I'm too scared! I'd finish soon with the help from a strong and heroic adventurer like you! Will you please help me? Of course, this is between you and me.
0.1: We've started a bet on who will become the offering to King Clang. At least we did start... But plans aren't going as we thought it would. Oh my gosh...we need to defeat all those #rClangs#k crawling on the beach.

yes.0: Ha! I knew you'd help me. Please take out #r50#k #rClangs#k for me. That will definitely show Rael and Roel who should be the sacrifice!

no.0: You mean you can't help me? ...NOO...! How can you not? Someone beautiful and graceful like me cannot stand up to an ugly Clang! You must help me!

1.0: Oh goody! I knew you'd help me! That was fast! You truly are my hero! You're the bravest adventurer I've ever met.

yes.0: Huh? You want me to call this bet off? You don't seem to understand a girl's wish. A maiden is the most beautiful when she is in distress. I've dreamed of this role for as long as I can remember. I will never give up... I am already the winner! I know it!

mob.0: You haven't defeated #r50 Clangs#k yet? I thought it wouldn't be so hard for someone like you to do the job. Try a little harder, please.
